title: Figure 38: Lockheed Star Clipper and McDonnell Douglas Model 176 (circa 1964) drawings
description: Two black-and-white perspective drawings of launch vehicles with lateral drop tanks, labeled "Lockheed Star Clipper circa 1964" (left) and "McDonnell Douglas Model 176 circa 1964" (right). Caption: "Figure 38. A 1964 MDC Astronautics, St. Louis, Briefing Defined a MOL Support System With 10 Launchers That Could Fly 100 Missions a Year for 15 Years. Lockheed Aircraft and McDonnell Douglas both had candidates." Text below begins the "Atmospheric Variations" section.
